summary: Phase 149O.1R -- Phase Report Evidence-Coherence Validator + Suppression Plumbing Repair: bounded cross-cutting repair of the two report-system defects independently identified by Phase 149O.1H.1R. B-149O.1R-1 (nested phase-ID extraction truncation) CLOSED: validate_internal_report_coherence() in src/pcae/core/phase_reports.py previously extracted evidence-phase-ID tokens with a regex whose dotted-segment group occurred at most once ((?:\.?\d+[A-Za-z]*)?), so a three-or-more-component canonical phase ID (149O.1H.1, 149O.1H.1R, and this repository's many other such IDs -- 149O.1B.1/.2/.3, 149O.1F.1/.2, etc.) could never be recognized as matching itself in its own evidence text, regardless of wording; reproduced directly against the real, unmodified promoted 149O.1H.1 report JSON before any edit (regex against 'Phase 149O.1H.1 repairs B-149O.1H-1' yielded only 'gu149O.1H', never 'gu149O.1H.1'). Repaired with a new boundary-anchored, unbounded-depth candidate span (_extract_evidence_phase_ids/_EVIDENCE_PHASE_TOKEN_RE) whose acceptance is delegated entirely to pcae.core.phase_id.parse() -- this repository's sole existing canonical phase-ID grammar authority (CPIPC-001 v1.0, Phase 137R), reused rather than re-implemented -- and whose current-phase comparison uses phase_id.equals()/same_series() (structural identity) instead of a dot-stripped string. Generic and not hardcoded to any specific phase ID (verified with 42Q.7C.9 and 3Z.1A.2B.4 test cases in addition to the two phases that exposed the defect); no shorter-prefix false match in either direction (current=149O.1H with evidence only naming 149O.1H.1 still fails, and vice versa, both independently tested); boundary-safe (x149O.1H.1, 149O.1H.1xyz, foo149O.1H.1bar, abc149O.1H.1def never extract 149O.1H.1 as a standalone token); malformed IDs (149O.., 149O.1H., .149O, 149O..1H, 149O.1H..1, 149O/1H/1) never extract themselves whole. B-149O.1R-2 (test_evidence_classification dropped before validation) CLOSED: traced both production paths that construct a PhaseReport -- pcae phase complete (commands/phase.py's _finalize_report_and_notify(), which reads many named fields out of .pcae/phase-completion-metadata.json but never this one, and neither the pre-check trial_report nor the actual finalize_phase_report() call forwarded it) and pcae phase-report create (commands/phase_reports.py's run_phase_report_create(), which had no CLI argument for it at all, confirmed by enumerating every pr_create_parser.add_argument call in src/pcae/cli.py) -- and confirmed finalize_phase_report() itself (core/phase_reports.py) only ever read commit_attribution and architecture_status_snapshot out of its own **kwargs, never this field. Repaired by: (1) finalize_phase_report() now reads kwargs.get('test_evidence_classification') and sets report.metadata accordingly, mirroring the existing commit_attribution pattern immediately above it; (2) commands/phase.py's _finalize_report_and_notify() now reads the field from canonical metadata, sets it on trial_report.metadata (so the pre-promotion gate sees it, not just the final promoted report), and forwards it to finalize_phase_report(); (3) src/pcae/cli.py gained exactly one new argument, --test-evidence-classification, on pr_create_parser; (4) commands/phase_reports.py's run_phase_report_create() reads it and sets report.metadata when supplied. No generic trust-bypass (--skip-trust/--ignore-coherence/--force-report) was added; the field's documented suppression semantics (Phase 134E.9: 'the only way to suppress' a legitimate same-series citation) were not broadened -- independently tested that the classification cannot manufacture missing current-phase evidence (assess_completeness() remains non-complete for a report with zero substantive test_results regardless of classification) and cannot hide a contradictory metadata['phase_id'] disagreement (that independent check still fires with classification set). Re-evaluating 149O.1H.1's and 149O.1H.1R's real, unmodified evidence text against the repaired validator (no evidence text rewritten): both now cohere -- direct simulation against the actual promoted 149O.1H.1 report JSON returns zero coherence issues both with and without the classification field set, because the regex fix alone is sufficient (149O.1H.1's own evidence text already names itself exactly). Files changed: src/pcae/core/phase_reports.py, src/pcae/commands/phase.py, src/pcae/commands/phase_reports.py, src/pcae/cli.py (production, all within phase-report trust plumbing), tests/test_phase_149o_1r_phase_report_evidence_coherence_validator_repair.py (new: 33 tests covering positive nested-ID recognition across 8 canonical examples, negative malformed-ID rejection, no-shorter-prefix extraction in both directions, prefix-collision attacks in both directions, boundary-safe extraction against 4 embedded-substring attacks, mixed current+historical evidence, historical-test-filename non-invalidation, generic-grammar non-hardcoding across 2 arbitrary phase IDs, classification plumbing reaching PhaseReport.metadata via finalize_phase_report, classification absence having no default suppression, classification JSON serialization round-trip, classification suppressing only the documented case, classification unable to manufacture missing evidence, classification unable to hide contradictory metadata, and 2 end-to-end pcae phase-report create CLI tests -- one promoting a nested-ID + classified report, one confirming a truly incoherent nested-ID report still quarantines), docs/PHASE_149O_1R_PHASE_REPORT_EVIDENCE_COHERENCE_VALIDATOR_REPAIR.md, PROJECT_STATUS.md, CHANGELOG.md, plus task-lifecycle files. git diff --name-only against the 149O.1H.1R baseline (59932a9f) confirms zero diff in human_approval_trusted_provenance.py, repository_identity.py, hatp_bootstrap.py, rollback_approval_evidence.py, permission_broker.py, permission_broker_foundation.py, mutation_permission.py, agent.py, commands/agent.py, and docs/contracts/. New test suite: 33 passed. Existing report-trust regressions (test_phase_reports.py, test_phase_reports_cli.py, test_phase_report_trust_hard_fail.py, test_push_phase_report_identity_137f1.py): 201 passed, no regression. Broader finalization/PFR/quarantine/task-finish suites (test_cltr_authority_136ap/aq/at/au, test_cltr_cutover_136v/w, test_finalization_configuration_identity_cross_agent_134b3, test_finalization_gate_enforcement, test_finalization_notification_guarantee, test_finalization_transaction_134e10, test_mutation_permission_promotion_integration, test_phase_113v_n_notification_finalization_repair, test_phase_137i1_finalization_ordering_deadlock, test_phase_complete_completion_metadata_shape_136aw, test_phase_report_trust_automation_gap_closure_design, test_phase_report_trust_gate, test_phase_report_trust_gate_cli, test_phase_report_view_134e3/134e3v, test_phase_reports_134e1v_identity_repair, test_repository_transition_validator_phase_complete_integration/task_finish_integration, test_staged_file_aware_task_finish, test_task_finish_notification_ordering/permission_non_interference/report_trust_notification): 1239 passed / 12 failed, all 12 independently confirmed pre-existing via git stash push -u baseline comparison (sdist/wheel packaging tests requiring an unrun build step, plus one pre-existing finalization test unrelated to this repair's scope). Fast Green (-m fast_green -n auto): 4530 passed / 1 failed pre-commit (the single failure, test_only_expected_production_files_changed in the 149O.1G suite, is the same live-uncommitted-working-tree-diff pattern 149O.1H.1's own report already documented and attributed to test design, not a regression -- confirmed passing again immediately after this phase's commit). Full whole-repository suite launched; see final report for disposition. HATP-001 v1.0 remains byte-unchanged. B-149O.1H-1 and B-149O.1H-2 remain CLOSED BY IMPLEMENTATION, PENDING INDEPENDENT 149O.1H.2 RE-VERIFICATION -- this phase does not itself independently re-verify Wave 3.
